sameAsTopCpu: All global styles (styleTitle, styleFirstLineText, StyleLeftAlign/StyleCenterAlign_r/StyleRightAlign_r, StyleBar, StyleHorizontalLine) -- unused decorative styles (StyleBar/StyleHorizontalLine) are declared globally but not referenced by any meter in either TopCPU.ini or TopRAM.ini.

backgroundSpec -- StyleBackground shape math is byte-for-byte identical (same include file, no per-skin overrides). See topcpu.json backgroundSpec for the full shape breakdown, including the Stroke_Width=0 (invisible frame) caveat.
Column X positions: Left=7 (ContentMarginFormula), Center=103 (CenterAlign), Right=197 (RightAlign).
Row stacking mechanics: row 1 at absolute Y=32 (TopMarginFormula), rows 2-N via Y=((count>=N)?RowSpacing:0)R chaining, sibling columns of a row share Y via Y=r.
Font: Trebuchet MS, 8pt Bold for all row text; FontColor threshold-swap uses colorRed at alpha 205 (colorTextAlpha), not colorRedAlpha(255) -- same nuance as TopCPU.
Substitute "":"---" on the primary (here: RAM) plugin measure; no other name-prettifying logic exists.
ClipString=1 + W=70 on the Left/name meter is what produces the visual ellipsis/truncation, not a text substitution.
Group=Controls meters (ControlSettings_, ControlSettings) are hover-reveal settings-gear chrome, excluded -- see 'skipped'.
keyDifferencesFromTopCpu: Panel is driven by RAM rank (Index=N on the RAM/primary UsageMonitor measure) instead of CPU rank; the paired secondary measure fetches CPU% of that same process via Name=[MeasureTopNRam].

Threshold semantics differ: TopRAMThreshold=500 is in MEGABYTES, and the IfCondition compares the raw byte value against '1024*1024*#TopRAMThreshold#' (=524,288,000 bytes) rather than a raw percent compare like TopCPU's threshold.
Column layout differs: Left=process name, CENTER=CPU% (not RAM), RIGHT=RAM autoscaled bytes (not CPU%) -- i.e. RAM and CPU% swap which side of center they're displayed on relative to TopCPU.
No MeasureProcessCount / MeterProcessCount / MeterProcessCountMouseRegion exist in this file at all -- TopRAM does not show a total running-process count.

The row's numeric RAM meter (MeterTopNRam, right column) reads directly from MeasureTopNRamCalcThreshold (the SAME Calc measure that also drives the threshold FontColor logic) rather than from a separate passthrough Calc measure. TopCPU, by contrast, keeps its threshold-Calc and its display-Calc as two distinct measures (MeasureTopNCpuThreshold vs MeasureTopNCpuRamCalc). Functionally equivalent value, different measure-chain shape.

The secondary CPU% measure (MeasureTopNCpu) has NO extra 'Calc' wrapper step in TopRAM.ini (unlike TopCPU.ini's MeasureTopNCpuRam -> MeasureTopNCpuRamCalc pair) -- it goes straight from the UsageMonitor plugin measure to OnChangeAction=[!UpdateMeterGroup ...], and the meter reads it inline via [MeasureTopNCpu:1]%.
ControlSettings_ gear icon X = (#RightAlign#-5) in TopRAM vs (#RightAlign#-30) in TopCPU (cosmetic-only, Group=Controls, not part of data display).
backgroundSpec: identical to topcpu.json's backgroundSpec -- see that file (StyleBackground include is shared, no per-skin override; Stroke_Width=0 so Shape7's outline frame is invisible here too).

notes: Threshold compares raw byte value to 1024*1024*TopRAMThreshold = 1024*1024*500 = 524,288,000 bytes (500 MiB), i.e. rows whose process RAM usage >= 500MB turn red.

Unlike TopCPU's Threshold measure, THIS measure is also the numeric data source for the visible right-hand RAM meter (MeterTopNRam reads MeasureName=MeasureTopNRamCalcThreshold directly) -- it does double duty as both the color-trigger and the display value.

MeasureTopNCpu.name: [MeasureTopNRam]
MeasureTopNCpu.note: Chains to the SAME process identified by MeasureTopNRam to fetch that process's CPU usage percent.
notes: No secondary 'Calc' step exists for this measure (contrast with TopCPU's MeasureTopNCpuRam->MeasureTopNCpuRamCalc pair) -- the center CPU% meter reads this plugin measure directly inline.

verticalFlowSummary: Background capsule -> Title row 'TOP RAM' centered at y=9 (abs) -- NOTE: unlike TopCPU there is no process-count element on this row at all -> Row1 (name/cpu%/ram) at y=32 (abs) -> Rows 2-5 stack via Y=1R chaining below the previous row's bottom -> Rows 6-10 present but Hidden+Disabled given NumberOfTopRamProc=5 -> MeterBackgroundHeight (invisible) 8px below the last meter, driving the background shape's total height.
notes: This file has NO equivalent of TopCPU's MeterProcessCount/MeasureProcessCount/MeterProcessCountMouseRegion -- confirmed absent from the source (meters go straight from ControlSettings_ to the Top1Ram row group). The 'TOP RAM' title row therefore has nothing right-aligned next to it.

Column semantics (verbatim from ini): Left=process name (ClipString+W=70, same truncation behavior as TopCPU), Center=CPU% of that process (static gray colorText2, never threshold-colored), Right=RAM usage autoscaled to '<n>.<d><K|M|G>B' with the threshold-driven color (colorText or colorRed@205 alpha) based on TopRAMThreshold=500MB.

Threshold math uses bytes, not percent: condition is raw_bytes >= 1024*1024*500 = 524288000. Make sure the reimplementation compares in bytes (or converts consistently) rather than reusing the CPU panel's plain '>= 20' percent-threshold logic.

All other mechanics (background shapes, Stroke_Width=0 invisible frame, font, row stacking Y formulas, hidden-meter stacking caveat, Substitute rule, ClipString truncation) are identical to TopCPU -- see topcpu.json for full detail rather than duplicating verbatim here.
